text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A year has already passed since learning of the "Legendary Kitchen Knife"
from the comments section of a livestream—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is the "Poisonous Plant Habitat"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally set off on a journey to find the legendary kitchen knife.
With a map I found on the internet in hand,
I forge ahead through the dark forest...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The plants growing around here will also give you a rash
if you touch them~
We better watch our step...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wait just a moment, okay?
...If it's this herb—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: (*munch*)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really is an herb!
I thought it smelled just like the ones I often use for making sweets.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"These herbs grow stronger the more they're stepped on.
Meaning it's proof of a walkable path! That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Relaaax, relax♪
Don't worry, let's keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, the fog is getting thicker...
Trainer, don't get separated from me, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Beast
text_block_list.text: Grrr, grrrr...!

text_block_list.name: Beast
text_block_list.text: GGYAGYAGYAAAAAA--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That was close~. Gotta make sure I can pull out that open-hand slap whenever I need to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the trick is to slam the base of your palm
right into it with a "BOOM☆"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's it!
You should get stronger too, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wah! What an incredible view!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Next time we come here, I wanna have a picnic.
When we do, I'll go catch that big fish swimming over there~!
choice_data_list: So you're going to cook with the legendary kitchen knife?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Let's invite everyone and...
Huh? A picnic? Camping?
Hehehe, I can't even tell anymore!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Smoothly following the map alongside Hishi Akebono,
and then...!"

text_block_list.name: Keeper
text_block_list.text:
You have done well to make it this far.
When so many dismiss it as mere rumor...
what a peculiar bunch you are.

text_block_list.name: Keeper
text_block_list.text: I shall grant thee the whereabouts of the legendary kitchen knife thou seekest.

text_block_list.name: Keeper
text_block_list.text: However! The legendary kitchen knife chooses its wielder! Those without strength cannot handle it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's that difficult...
I have to earn Mr. Kitchen Knife's approval first, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—It has been a perilous journey up to this point.
Yet, that we made it here safely
is all thanks to Hishi Akebono."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way someone as dependable as
Hishi Akebono could ever be powerless!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! All right, let's—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Time to eat!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's already dinnertime!
"You can't fight on an empty stomach," right~?

text_block_list.name: Keeper
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It seems you understand the importance of food.
So then, what exactly do you plan to make?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Today's dinner is~ minestrone and~,
herb-roasted chicken, and—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! I forgot to bring a kitchen knife!
Um, uh—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's a kitchen knife stuck in that rock, isn't it?
I'll just borrow it for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Keeper
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, your fortitude is admirable... but reckless.
That kitchen knife happens to be the 'Legendary Knife'—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pop!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
